summary: Founder Command Center end-to-end testing complete. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_command_center.py covering dashboard shape, page codes (auto-gen + override + uniqueness), structure update, minion directory (10 minions), batch-launch (empty/skip/unknown), batch-generate (empty/sets Generating), and regression on /api/pages and /api/worker-queue/stats. Frontend /command page renders perfectly: header shows '25 pages · 4 review · 2 launch · 4 live · 13 planned'; stats row displays 4/2/4/13/0/13 (Review/Launch/Live/Planned/Blocked/Generate); all 5 section tabs (actions, review, launch, blocked, structure) clickable and render correct content; 5 action cards visible (review:4 with code chips T3/S3/T1/S1, launch:2 with D1/D2 + Launch All button, generate:13 with C2/GP1/GP3/CS2/CS3/CS4 +4 more, worker_execute:9 with Go to Workers btn, worker_review:10); Structure tab shows all 25 pages with auto-generated codes following the scheme (CH1, D1-D4, T1-T4, S1-S4, CS1-CS4, C1-C3, GP1-GP3, A1-A2); page family colors render correctly; WP IDs shown for placed pages (354779/780/781/782); 'Command Center' is the top nav item. No JS errors on the page (pre-login 401s are expected). Login with TSFounder!Vault2026#Secure successful via cookie-based POST /api/auth/login.

minor.issue: Endpoint sets a Planned page to 'Generating' but there is no observed downstream worker that picks it up automatically — actual content generation requires a separate /api/page-ops/generate trigger per the task spec. Behavior matches spec but consider adding a queue task or a UI hint that this is a status-only marker.
Override accepts any uppercase string (e.g., 'TESTZ99') with no scheme validation. Acceptable for founder override per spec, but could optionally warn if prefix doesn't match family scheme.

issues: Action cards use uses native window.alert() in handleBatchLaunch — consider toast notifications for consistency with other pages.
Structure map tab on long lists has no pagination/virtualization — fine at 25 pages, watch as list grows beyond 100.

critical_code_review_comments: services/command_center.py is clean and well-organized at ~310 lines; FAMILY_CODE_MAP, ensure_all_page_codes idempotency, blocked/unlock computation, and structure_map projection all correct.
routes/command_center.py correctly excludes _id via projection on every find. Auth required via Depends(get_current_user) on every endpoint — verified by test_dashboard_unauth (returns 401/403).
generate_page_code uses simple max+1 logic per family — race-safe under single-process; if scaled to multiple workers, code generation should use a Mongo $inc counter to avoid duplicates.

compute_blocked_pages uses parent_page string match by id OR page_name — works but mixing identifier types is fragile. Consider standardizing parent_page to always be a page_id, with page_name resolved at read time only.

batch_launch correctly delegates to services.worker_queue.route_page_to_wp and is non-blocking on per-page errors (collects in results.errors). Idempotency handled by route_page_to_wp's existing-task check (per iteration 32 verification).

batch_generate only sets status='Generating' with no cleanup or task creation — if Page Ops generate flow fails or is never triggered, the page stays stuck in 'Generating' indefinitely. Consider adding a worker_task entry for generation or a stale-Generating watchdog.

Frontend CommandCenter.js (~451 lines) is a single component — already approaching split threshold; consider extracting StructureMap, ActionCard, and ReadyForReviewList into subcomponents when next feature lands.
Frontend uses axios with withCredentials: true — correct for cookie-based auth setup.
data-testid coverage is excellent: command-center, stats-row, section-tabs, tab-{key}, {section}-section, action-{type}, batch-launch-btn, launch-all-btn — easy to test.
Minor: BatchLaunchRequest and BatchGenerateRequest both use list[str] — Pydantic v2 syntax is fine. Both have empty-list 400 guard.
seed_data_creation: test_batch_generate_sets_generating moved one Planned page (CS1 Toys Collection) to status='Generating'. This shows in the structure map screenshot as a yellow pulsing dot. Main agent may want to revert via DB or by triggering Page Ops generate on it. test_update_page_code_override and test_update_titles modified one page's code (restored) and titles (left as TEST_WORKING_TITLE / TEST_PUBLIC_TITLE — minor, founder can rename via /command structure dialog).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Command Center is at /command. Backend tests in test_command_center.py serve as regression. The page CS1 (Toys Collection) was set to Generating during this test and one page has TEST_ titles set. After main agent runs Page Ops generate or reverts, totals should return to: 4 review / 2 launch / 4 live / 14 planned / 0 blocked. Batch-launch on D1/D2 was NOT executed in this iteration — those still appear as Approved. To test full launch flow, POST {page_ids:[D1_id, D2_id]} to /api/command-center/batch-launch — will create wp_placement worker tasks (per iteration 32 mechanics) which then need to be executed via /api/worker-queue/tasks/{id}/execute.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. All 17 backend tests pass; frontend renders cleanly with all data-testids present and all tabs/buttons functional.
